def xml_to_url_list(xml_string):
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_string)
    url_list = []
    for item in root.findall('./url/item'):
        url_list.append(item.text)
    return url_list

def conditional_probability(theta_i_y, theta_i_j, lambda_i, lambda_j, y):
    # Compute the numerator of the conditional probability
    numerator = np.exp(theta_i_y * (lambda_i == y) + theta_i_j * (lambda_i == lambda_j))
    # Compute the partition function
    Z = np.sum(np.exp(theta_i_y * (lambda == y) + theta_i_j * (lambda == lambda_j)))
    # Normalize to obtain the final probability
    conditional_prob = numerator / Z
    return conditional_prob
